thread:
elaine: quick sync — ACME wants model-routing parity + tenant controls in 8 weeks. they said launch or we lose the pilot.

todd: ugh. parity in 8w is tight. we can either scope down to a minimal compatibility shim or push for a small differentiator that buys retention but takes longer.

maya: stats: parity shim = ~3 sprints (team of 4) with risk on token-format compatibility. differentiator (routing + UI preview) = ~6 sprints, higher conversion potential.

sam: what does legal/customer ops need to sign off? if pilot hinges on parity we should prioritize that.

dylan: @sam we have two asks from acme: Tenant-level routing policy + per-tenant fallback override. they call both "compat controls". The product ask in their doc implies parity with competitor X's API surface.

elaine: can we do a hybrid? ship a minimal API shim that looks like competitor X (parity) + a fast toggle for tenant fallback (thin UI) — then continue the differentiator work post-launch.

todd: hybrid is doable but we must be explicit about tradeoffs. if we build the shim as an adapter we avoid changing runtime routing but add translation overhead. latency impact ~5-8% on that route.

maya: acceptance criteria proposal (PR):
```
- API adapter responds to competitor X headers + maps to Redwood routing config
- tenant fallback toggle in console (toggle only, no audit logs for v1)
- per-route latency < 120ms p50 additional for adapter
- integration tests for header mapping
```

sam: customers will accept v1 without audit logs for pilot, sales confirmed. Need SLA note for latency bump.

dylan: ops: estimate for dedicated capacity: +1 GPU for 3 months if we enable translation adapter at scale. cost = estimate attached.

elaine: decision time. options: (A) Full differentiator (6sprints) — better product but miss pilot. (B) Hybrid parity+toggle (3 sprints) — meets pilot, modest perf hit, follow-up roadmap for diff. (C) Minimal parity only (2 sprints) — fastest but no retention features.

todd: +1 for B. minimizes churn and keeps us in pilot while leaving room.

maya: +1 B. schedule: sprint 1 adapter + tests, sprint 2 console toggle + e2e, sprint 3 safety/rollout, canary.

sam: +1 B. sales to ACME: confirm pilot timeline and get written acceptance on v1 scope.

dylan: ops +1 B with condition to flag spike monitor and a rollback plan.

launch-bot: deploy-plan: canary window 24h, rollback hook present.

elaine: consensus = B. action items: @todd pick implementation owner by EOD, @maya draft AC acceptance language, @sam update customer comms, @dylan queue capacity estimate for finance. I'll add to roadmap and scope doc.

todd: assigning to me. starting spec PR now.

maya: drafting acceptance language, will tag legal.

sam: will update ACME and ask for written OK.

dylan: will add capacity ask to budgeting doc.

elaine: great. we'll reconvene in 2 days for blocker check. :thumbsup:
